title: Derived fibres of the explicit canonical structure map
statement: Let f : X → S be a quasi-compact separated flat morphism of schemes [def-pc-morphism-conventions, def-weil-flat-morphism], with shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Put J = O_S[0], E = Rf_*(O_X[0]) [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and a = single(f♯) followed by canonicalSingleDirectImageMap f O_X [lem-pc-canonical-single-direct-image-comparison]. For every s in S and i < 0, H^i(Li_s^* E) = 0 [def-pc-derived-pullback]. If the canonical ring map κ(s) → Γ(X_s,O_X_s) [def-pc-base-change] is invertible, then H^0(Li_s^* a) is invertible. The map a is this explicit canonical composite, not an arbitrary morphism J → E.

proof.text: For each residue field square, use isIso_derivedBaseChange_of_flat_invertible at the structure module. Compose with derived direct image of canonicalSinglePullbackMap and the ordinary adjoint structure-sheaf isomorphism to obtain the isomorphism b to the derived direct image of the fibre structure module.

The source PlusCompatibility lemma isGE_rightDerivedFunctor_obj_singleFunctor gives nonnegative cohomology of the derived direct image of the fibre structure module. Apply isGE_iff and transport IsZero through homologyFunctor.mapIso of b.

Apply canonical_structure_map_base_change to the residue-field square to obtain Lg*(a) followed by b equal to j followed by the fibre structure map a prime. The pinned pullback comparison and the ordinary adjoint structure map make j invertible.

On Spec of a field every open is empty or whole. Forget the ordinary module structure map to a presheaf of additive groups; at the empty open both section rings are subsingleton by the terminal-empty-open sheaf condition, and at the whole open its underlying map is appTop. Hence IsIso appTop implies the ordinary module structure map is invertible. canonicalDirectImageH0Unit makes degree-zero homology of the direct-image single comparison invertible by cancellation. Apply homology to the equation from the previous step and cancel homology of b to obtain the degree-zero assertion.

theorem flat_derived_structure_unit_properties
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f] [Flat f] :
    (∀ (s : S) (i : ℤ), i < 0 → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (S.residueField s)).toRingedSpace)) i).obj
        ((derivedPullback (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).obj
          ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)))))) ∧
    (∀ s : S, IsIso (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s).appTop →
      IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (S.residueField s)).toRingedSpace)) 0).map
          ((derivedPullback (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).map
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).map
                (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom) ≫
              Scheme.Modules.canonicalSingleDirectImageMap f
                (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)))))
